messages:
Maya Patel: quick async check — what I did: rolled routing-policy v2 to canary (10%), fixed header-rewrite edge bug. Blocker: seeing a small spike of 429s for ~1% of requests with long path params. Today: will debug token-bucket behavior and verify pool configs. cc @Tom Nguyen @Alex Chen @Sophia Ruiz :coffee:

Tom Nguyen: saw the same 429s in staging around 10:13. Traces show short-lived KV cache misses and a smearing of bursts. I can pull tails and link logs.

Maya Patel: thanks — request id example: `req=stg_20250314_9ab3` and sample path: `/v1/generate/very/long/path/that/contains/many/segments?user=...`

Tom Nguyen: grabbing logs now. tail command: `kubectl logs -l app=gateway -n staging -f --tail=300` will include the req id. will paste link in a sec. :eyes:

Alex Chen: quick theory — staging burst capacity might be disabled for that pool, so token refill can't absorb short spikes. Check `routing.policy.burst` and token-refill settings. I can open a 1-line PR to bump refill rate if you want.

Sophia Ruiz: re: auth — I rebased the authz change last night and ran the smoke suite. No conflicts. If canary needs a flag toggle for auth-exempt routes, I can flip it.

Ravi Patel: reminder of SLOs: if 429s exceed 0.5% sustained -> initiate rollback. Can we add a quick metric alert for `gateway.429.rate` in staging (threshold 0.5% over 5m)? I can add an alert now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (id 1756765429) -> 10% traffic. Monitoring: latency and error windows open.

Tom Nguyen: log link: https://logs.internal/redwood/staging/gateway?query=req%3Dstg_20250314_9ab3 — shows TTL refresh failing for a few KB of responses around 10:13. Root cause still fuzzy, posting snippet:
```
ERROR gateway: kv_cache_miss: key=prefix-xyz ttl=0 req=stg_20250314_9ab3
WARN  token_bucket: insufficient_tokens route=/v1/generate/... client=svc-frontend
```
Maya Patel: good catch. Alex, if you can PR the refill bump that would help verify. Ravi, thanks — please add the alert. Sophia, I'll ping you if we need the flag toggled.

Alex Chen: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/4287 — increases token refill by 20% and keeps same burst cap. small test included. :thumbsup:

Ravi Patel: alert created: staging-gateway-429-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> alert page on-call. ID: ALERT-1729.

Maya Patel: perfect. plan: monitor for next 20m, if 429 stays >0.5% rollback to policy v1. I'll update thread. thanks all. :rocket:
